title: anthemis tricolor subsp. plutonia
intro: Anthemis tricolor subsp. plutonia, commonly known as Chrysanthemum tricolor, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its therapeutic properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Anthemis tricolor subsp. plutonia include the treatment of fever, skin conditions, and respiratory problems, while its therapeutic actions involve soothing and calming the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
